translationRepairs: On dingyou day, Prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui, was restored as Military Commissioner of Bian and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, became Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, became Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, became Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; and Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was appointed General of the Left Guard.

On dingyou day, Prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui, was restored as Military Commissioner of Chan and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, became Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, became Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, became Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; and Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was appointed General of the Left Guard.
澶州 is Chan/Chanzhou, not Bian (汴). The appointment restores Rong as jiedushi of Chan prefecture.

On the day dingyou, the prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army's personal guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui prefecture, was restored to office as Military Commissioner of Bian prefecture and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, was made Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was made General of the Left Guard.

On the day dingyou, the prince Rong, Inner Commander of the Tianxiong Army's personal guard and Acting Right Vice Director, Prefect of Gui prefecture, was restored to office as Military Commissioner of Chan prefecture and Acting Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan, General of the Right Golden Guard, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Forest Feather Guard; Zhao Zan, General of the Left Swift Horse Guard, was made Commander of the Right Forest Feather Guard; Song Yanyun, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was made General of the Left Guard.
澶州 is Chan prefecture; Bian is 汴. The literal rendering mistranslates the toponym.

On jihai day, Liu Suening, General of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, became Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; and Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, became General of the Right Guard.

On jihai day, Liu Suining, General of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, became Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; and Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, became General of the Right Guard.
劉遂凝 is Liu Suining (Suìníng); Suening is a misspelling of the given name.

On the day jihai, Liu Suening, General of the Left Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, was made Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, was made General of the Right Guard.

On the day jihai, Liu Suining, General of the Left Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, General of the Left Guard, was made Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; Shi Quan, General of the Left Military Guard, was made General of the Right Guard.
劉遂凝 is Liu Suining; the literal line repeats the same misspelling.

On xinhai day, Yang Ningshi moved from Junior Tutor to Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao from Director of Imperial Sacrifices to Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi from Left Vice Director of State Affairs to Minister of Rites; Bian Wei from Vice Minister of War to Director of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafting Official, to Vice Minister of Works; Wei Xun from Vice Minister of Revenue to Vice Minister of War; Bian Guichan from Vice Minister of Justice to Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu from Vice Minister of Rites to Vice Minister of Justice; Zhao Shangjiao from Director of the Secretariat to Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu from Minister of War to Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, to Minister of Justice; Tian Min from Right to Left Vice Director of State Affairs; Duan Xiyao from Vice Minister of Personnel to Minister of Works; and Ma Yisun from Chamberlain for the Heir Apparent to Advisor to the Crown Prince.

On xinhai day, Yang Ningshi moved from Junior Tutor to Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao from Director of Imperial Sacrifices to Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi from Left Vice Director of State Affairs to Minister of Rites; Bian Wei from Vice Minister of War to Director of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafting Official, to Vice Minister of Works; Wei Xun from Vice Minister of Revenue to Vice Minister of War; Bian Guichan from Vice Minister of Justice to Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu from Vice Minister of Rites to Vice Minister of Justice; Zhao Shangjiao from Director of the Palace Library to Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu from Minister of War to Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, to Minister of Justice; Tian Min from Right to Left Vice Director of State Affairs; Duan Xiyao from Vice Minister of Personnel to Minister of Works; and Ma Yisun from Chamberlain for the Heir Apparent to Advisor to the Crown Prince.
秘書監 is the Palace Library directorate, not the Secretariat (中書).

On the day xinhai, Yang Ningshi, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Minister of Rites; Bian Wei, Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafting Official, was made Vice Minister of Works in his office; Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War; Bian Guichan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Zhao Shangjiao, Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu, Minister of War, was made Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice in his office; Tian Min, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works; Ma Yisun, Chamberlain for the Heir Apparent, was made Advisor to the Crown Prince.

秘書監 is the Palace Library, not the Secretariat.

On jiwei day, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Concurrent Grand Councilor; former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao became Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.

On jiwei day, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Concurrent Grand Councilor; former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao became Chamberlain for the Guards.
衛尉卿 is the Court of the Imperial Guards/Regalia, not the Imperial Clan (宗正).

On the day jiwei, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Concurrent Grand Councilor; the former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.

衛尉卿 is not the Imperial Clan office.

On xinyou day, Bian Guangfan moved from Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan to Director of the Secretariat; former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang returned as Vice Minister of Personnel; and former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan became Right Vice Director of State Affairs.

On xinyou day, Bian Guangfan moved from Chamberlain for the Guards to Director of the Palace Library; former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang returned as Vice Minister of Personnel; and former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan became Right Vice Director of State Affairs.
衛尉卿 is the Guards chamberlain and 秘書監 is the Palace Library, not Imperial Clan or Secretariat.

On the day xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, was made Director of the Secretariat; the former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Personnel; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

On the day xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Chamberlain for the Guards, was made Director of the Palace Library; the former Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Personnel; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Kan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
Same office mistranslations as the idiomatic line: 衛尉卿 and 秘書監.

On wuchen day, former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was granted retirement as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, and former Military Commissioner of Xing An Shenhui as retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

On wuchen day, former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was granted retirement as Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince, and former Military Commissioner of Xing, An Shenhui, as retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
太子太傅 is Grand Mentor and 太子太師 is Grand Preceptor; also 邢州安審暉 is An Shenhui of Xing, not the fused name Xing An Shenhui.

On the day wuchen, the former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; the former Military Commissioner of Xing prefecture An Shenhui was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

On the day wuchen, the former General of the Left Martial Guard Li Huaizhong was made retired Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince; the former Military Commissioner of Xing prefecture An Shenhui was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
Literal already separates Xing prefecture from An Shenhui but swaps 太傅 (Mentor) and 太師 (Preceptor).

Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; former Junior Prefect of Daming Li Qiong became Director of Palace Construction; former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi received retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, was placed in charge of arrangements for Hidden Emperor of Han's mausoleum.

Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; former Junior Prefect of Daming Li Qiong became Director of Palace Construction; former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi received retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Guards, was placed in charge of arrangements for Hidden Emperor of Han's mausoleum.

The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously created Minister of Revenue; the late Crown Prince's Advisor Xiao Yuan, Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Imperial Granaries, became Chamberlain for Dependencies; Wu Zhao, retired Director of Palace Construction, Chamberlain for the Imperial Household; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices, Director of the Palace Workshop; and Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Secretariat, Director of Palace Construction.

On renyin day, the Khitan sent You military adjutant Cao Jijun to return the remains of late Jin Director of the Secretariat Zhao Ying; the court posthumously created him Grand Preceptor, granted his son five hundred bolts of silk for the funeral, and ordered burial in his native Huayin.

太傅 is Grand Mentor; Grand Preceptor is 太師.

On the day renyin, the Khitan sent Cao Jijun, a military adjutant of You prefecture, to return the remains of the late Jin Director of the Secretariat Zhao Ying; an edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor and also granted his son five hundred bolts of silk for funeral expenses, with burial in his old home in Huayin.
